title: Sword · hit
description: Native longsword hit; contact, damage and body recovery.

title: Sword · miss
description: Native miss; no fabricated damage and independent miss feedback.

title: Sword · critical
description: Critical profile, hit flash and retained damage.

title: Dagger · piercing profile
description: Same attack executor selects the authored piercing variant.

title: Shortbow · hit
description: Authored ranged body release, flight, arrival and HP application.

title: Shortbow · diagonal miss
description: Miss across a diagonal.

title: Goblin · reversed ranged attack
description: Reversed attacker/recipient. This pack lacks a bow body; the media gap stays visible.

title: Walk · clear path
description: Committed movement with no adjacent enemy reaction.

title: Jump · clear path
description: Uninterrupted authored jump curve over an actual committed Step.

title: Walk → opportunity hit → paralysis
description: Native longsword paralysis rider; failed CON10 save stops a living mover. This is not a Hold Person spell proc.

title: Walk → opportunity hit → save → continue
description: The complete reaction joins, then the committed movement continues.

title: Walk → opportunity miss → continue
description: Miss without a save or damage; continuation retains the original path.

title: Walk → lethal opportunity attack
description: The native lethal result stops the Step and plays the death body.

title: Jump → opportunity hit → paralysis
description: The interrupted jump keeps its visible position and height; the legal Step remains at its origin.

title: Jump → opportunity hit → save → continue
description: Jump resumes the original curve after the full reaction finishes.

title: Jump → opportunity miss → continue
description: Miss during a jump, including held and resumed lift.

title: Jump → lethal opportunity attack
description: Death during a held jump; no uncommitted destination is presented as the settled state.

title: Reaction · historical clock paused
description: Offline retained playback pauses for 750ms; latest is already reduced. This checks the same sampler at a frozen presentation time, not live controller scheduling.

title: Fire Bolt · two casts on level support
description: Two real casts in one retained sequence, both actors on the upper terrace.

title: Fire Bolt · lower to upper support
description: Current game composition across the original difficult stair; retain any visible clipping for review.

title: Magic Missile · A / B / A, twice
description: Original authored Rune Dart, repeated application identities and cumulative HP across two casts.

title: Cast → replace weapon → cast
description: Two casts around four actual equipment roots; each root reduces in order through the game playback path.

title: Paralysis → save → next turn → walk
description: Native end-turn save removes the exact owned conditions; next turn Disengage and Move resume from the held visual position.

title: Paralysis → save → next turn → jump
description: Held jump position and lift survive intervening native turn/removal roots, then a discovered Jump starts from that pose.

title: Paralysis → failed repeat save → restricted turn
description: The native repeat save fails; exact condition membership and action restrictions persist into the next turn.

title: Failed repeat save → later success → walk
description: A failed native repeat save retains paralysis; a later successful save removes it before legal movement resumes.

title: Dodge → opponent action → natural expiry
description: Discovered Dodge persists across the other actor's turn/action and expires through the engine's next-turn condition owner.

title: Paused paralysis while latest already recovered
description: Historical playback freezes with the actual paralysis memberships while latest has already removed them and completed the next movement.

title: Healing · capped living recipient
description: Native healing restores only missing HP at entry; the original green Heal number survives the immediate head for its authored 900ms.

title: Healing · dying player restored
description: Native DYING→ALIVE healing commits HP and emits the original Heal number and Revived badge. Both mechanical states use Idle in NeuroClient; there is no authored stand-up clip.

title: Death save · ordinary success
description: Real turn-start natural 13; original Death save badge, still DYING.

title: Death save · ordinary failure
description: Real turn-start natural 5; original Death save failed badge, still DYING.

title: Death save · critical failure
description: Real natural 1 contributes two failures; original Critical failure badge, still DYING.

title: Death save · critical recovery
description: Real natural 20 restores 1 HP through its Heal child; original Critical death save!, Heal and Revived feedback.

title: Three saves → stable → later healing
description: Three real successful saves stabilize the player. Later native healing restores 5 HP; original Stable and Revived badges.

title: Failed saves → death → later revival
description: Native failure/success/critical failure causes death. The original Die body plays once, the corpse persists through real intervening roots, and actual revival restores Idle and 3 HP.

title: Paused death while latest already revived
description: The historical Die animation pauses while latest has already processed actual revival. All four camera views retain identical state and pixels during the pause.

title: Walk → opportunity hit → DYING
description: Actual opportunity damage downs a player using death saves and stops the Step. Original TakeDamage returns to Idle with the Dying badge; Die is reserved for actual death.
